evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposed a new learning-based approach for simulating Multiple Scattering phenomena using the BEM framework in which a GNN is leveraged as a surrogate model for replacing the BIE solver, leading to a reduction of the simulation runtime by two orders of magnitude.
